title: Module:Skill
text: local p = {} -- In-game style card for a skill: icon, skill line, name, element and rank, mana, range, cast time, cooldown, -- effects granted (buff icons), the description, the damage formula, combos and the chain it belongs to. Data: Module:Data/SkillCards/... (sync_wiki_data.py), or live from the APIs. -- The hover boxes of mount, glider and pet skills (Module:Mount) are a different thing and stay as they are. local IconName = require('Module:IconName') local Store = require('Module:DataStore') local Consumable = require('Module:Consumable') local function trim(s) return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or '')) end local function esc(s) return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|') end local FLOATS = { right = 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 0.5em 1em;', left = 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 1em 0.5em 0;', center = 'margin:0 auto 0.5em auto;', } local function fetched(s) s = trim(s) if s:find('class="error"', 1, true) then return '' end return s end local function num(v) v = tonumber(v) if not v then return 0 end return v end local function n(x) if x == math.floor(x) then return string.format('%d', x) end return string.format('%.1f', x) end -- 24000 -> "24sec", 90000 -> "1min 30sec", 900000 -> "15min" local function dur(ms) local total = num(ms) / 1000 local m = math.floor(total / 60) local s = total - m * 60 local out = {} if m > 0 then out[#out + 1] = m .. 'min' end if s > 0 or m == 0 then out[#out + 1] = n(s) .. 'sec' end return table.concat(out, ' ') end -- Unfilled placeholders of the game text. #{avg_damage}#{detail_melee_damage} (two in a row) is the damage: the game -- shows "2180 (0 + 267% Melee Attack)", here the formula "(260% Melee Attack)" in green. Others show "(varies)". local function holders(s, formulaText) s = tostring(s or '') -- no thousands separators (2,493 -> 2493), so the numbers look the same on every card repeat local before = s s = s:gsub('(%d),(%d%d%d)', '%1%2') if s == before then break end until false -- the damage of the skill: #{avg_damage}#{detail_spell_damage} or #{buff_total_avg_damage}#{detail_spell_damage} s = s:gsub('#%b{}%s*#{detail_[%w_]+}', function() return formulaText and ('|cFF6FD16F(' .. formulaText .. ')|r') or '(varies)' end) local prev repeat prev = s s = s:gsub('(#%b{})%s*%-?%s*#%b{}', '%1') -- #{a}#{b} and #{min}-#{max}: one value until s == prev return (s:gsub('#%b{}', function(token) if formulaText and token == '#{avg_damage}' then return '|cFF6FD16F(' .. formulaText .. ')|r' end -- a total that is not the damage formula (damage over time of a buff): the number is not known return '(varies)' end)) end -- 260 -> "260", 0.5 -> "0.5" local function g(x) x = tonumber(x) or 0 if x == math.floor(x) then return string.format('%d', x) end return (string.format('%.2f', x):gsub('0+$', '')) end -- the damage formula as the data gives it: "0 + 260% Melee Attack" or "18-30 + 290% Melee Attack" local function formula(list) local parts = {} for _, x in ipairs(type(list) == 'table' and list or {}) do local text = g(x.pct) .. '% ' .. trim(x.stat ~= nil and x.stat or 'Attack') if x.fmax ~= nil then -- the flat part, also when it is 0: "(0 + 267% Melee Attack)" local flat = g(x.fmin) if num(x.fmax) ~= num(x.fmin) then flat = flat .. '-' .. g(x.fmax) end text = flat .. ' + ' .. text end if x.lvl then text = text .. ', scales with level' end parts[#parts + 1] = text end if #parts == 0 then return nil end return table.concat(parts, ' + ') end -- small icon of the wiki (an effect, a skill) local function pic(icon, size) local f = IconName.iconFile(icon) if f == '' then return '' end return '[[File:' .. f .. '|' .. size .. 'px|link=]]' end -- 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th ... 11th, 21st local function ordinal(i) local last, teen = i % 10, i % 100 local suffix = 'th' if teen < 11 or teen > 13 then suffix = (last == 1 and 'st') or (last == 2 and 'nd') or (last == 3 and 'rd') or 'th' end return i .. suffix end -- data of the card: stored, or built from the live arguments of Template:Skill local function data(a) local d = Store.get('SkillCards', a.id) if d then return d end local name = fetched(a.name) if name == '' then return nil end return { name = name, icon = fetched(a.icon), line = fetched(a.line), desc = fetched(a.desc), cd = num(fetched(a.cd)), cast = num(fetched(a.cast)), mana = num(fetched(a.mana)), minr = num(fetched(a.minr)), maxr = num(fetched(a.maxr)), rad = num(fetched(a.rad)), labor = num(fetched(a.labor)) } end -- one line of the box local function line(root, class, text) root:tag('div'):addClass(class):wikitext(text) end -- Effects with ranks (Magic Circle Rank 1 ... Rank 5): the data keeps all of them (rk = the rank); a card shows the -- one of its rank, or when the rank is unknown the lowest. A rank that does not exist: the closest lower one. local function ranked(buffs, want) local t = tonumber(want) or 1 local function score(r) if r <= t then return t - r end return 1000 + (r - t) end local out, pos = {}, {} for _, b in ipairs(type(buffs) == 'table' and buffs or {}) do if not tonumber(b.rk) then out[#out + 1] = b else local key = tostring(b.icon) .. '|' .. trim((tostring(b.name or ''):gsub('%s*%(?[Rr]ank %d+%)?%s*$', ''))) local i = pos[key] if not i then out[#out + 1] = b pos[key] = #out elseif score(tonumber(b.rk)) < score(tonumber(out[i].rk)) then out[i] = b end end end return out end -- one card. id: the skill ID. ctx (only for a skill with a chain or versions): setId (prefix of the anchor ids), -- v (number of the version shown), k (position of the card in its chain), links (chain skills whose card can be -- opened, by id), reserve, vers (the versions: idx, elem), pick(w) (the position to open in version w) local function build(d, id, a, ctx) ctx = ctx or {} local setId, links, reserve = ctx.setId, ctx.links, ctx.reserve local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-skill') -- in a skill tree the icons of the card are not focusable (their boxes open on hover): a click inside the card then keeps the -- focus on the tile, so the card stays open and the rest of the tree stays locked. (A plain card keeps them, for touch and keyboard.) local tab = (not a.tileicon) and '0' or nil local dmgText = formula(d.dmg) local buffs = ranked(d.buffs, ctx.rank or (a.ranks and a.ranks[tonumber(id)] or nil)) -- the tree can give the duration (ms) a buff really has at the shown rank, by buff name (the tree data writes seconds: bdur = { ['Ice Shard'] = 6.2 }) if type(d.bdur) == 'table' and type(buffs) == 'table' then local nb = {} for i, b in ipairs(buffs) do local c = {} for k, v in pairs(b) do c[k] = v end if d.bdur[c.name] then c.dur = d.bdur[c.name] end nb[i] = c end buffs = nb end -- an effect that needs a passive (Mana Fountain: Requires Mana Flurry) goes first, so its requirement line sits under it do local first, rest = {}, {} for _, b in ipairs(buffs) do if type(b.req) == 'table' and trim(b.req.name) ~= '' then first[#first + 1] = b else rest[#rest + 1] = b end end for _, b in ipairs(rest) do first[#first + 1] = b end buffs = first end -- header: icon, skill line, name (with the rank, like the game); at the right the element (Quake, Life ...) local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-head') local file = IconName.iconFile(d.icon) if file ~= '' then head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-icon'):wikitext('[[File:' .. file .. '|48px|link=]]') end local title = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-title') if trim(d.line) ~= '' then title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-line'):wikitext(esc(d.line)) end local name = trim(d.name) if num(d.rank) > 0 then name = name .. ' (Rank ' .. n(num(d.rank)) .. ')' end title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-name'):wikitext(esc(name)) -- an item that raises the rank of the skill (Fantasia of Sorcery): its icon is a switch between the card and the same -- card one rank higher (rank and effect of that rank); left of the versions, so those stay where they are if ctx.boostBtn and IconName.iconFile(ctx.boostBtn.item.icon) ~= '' then local bb = ctx.boostBtn local plus = tonumber(bb.item.plus) or 1 local btn = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-boost') if bb.on then btn:addClass('aa-skill-boost-on') end btn:wikitext('[[File:' .. IconName.iconFile(bb.item.icon) .. '|30px|link=#' .. bb.target .. ']]') local tip = btn:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip') tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname'):wikitext(esc(bb.item.name)) tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftext'):wikitext('Increases the rank of ' .. esc(trim(d.name)) .. ' by +' .. n(plus) .. '. ' .. (bb.on and 'Click to switch it off.' or 'Click to switch it on.')) end local nvers = 0 for _, w in ipairs(ctx.vers or {}) do if not w.boost then nvers = nvers + 1 end -- (the card with the rank item is not a version) end if nvers > 1 then -- the versions of the skill (Basic, Quake, Lightning ...): the shown one is bold, a click on another opens it local tag = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-tag') for _, w in ipairs(ctx.vers) do if not w.boost then local item = tag:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-elem') if w.idx == (ctx.vcur or ctx.v) then item:addClass('aa-skill-elem-cur'):wikitext(esc(w.elem)) else item:addClass('aa-skill-elem-alt'):wikitext('[[#' .. setId .. 'v' .. w.idx .. 'k' .. ctx.pick(w) .. '|' .. esc(w.elem) .. ']]') end end end elseif trim(d.elem) ~= '' then head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-tag'):tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-elem'):wikitext(esc(d.elem)) end -- mana, range, effect range, attack percent (only what the data has) local mana, maxr, rad = num(d.mana), num(d.maxr), num(d.rad) local first = type(d.dmg) == 'table' and d.dmg[1] or nil if mana > 0 or maxr > 0 or rad > 0 or first or d.caster or d.charges then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep') if d.charges then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta aa-skill-orange', 'Abyssal Charges ' .. esc(d.charges)) end if mana > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Mana ' .. n(mana)) end if d.caster then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Range: Caster only') elseif maxr > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Range: ' .. n(num(d.minr)) .. '-' .. n(maxr) .. ' m') end if rad > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Effect Range: ' .. n(rad) .. ' m') end if first then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', esc(trim(first.stat ~= nil and first.stat or 'Attack') .. ' +' .. g(first.pct) .. '%')) end end -- cast time, cooldown, channeling, labor root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep') local cast = num(d.cast) line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', cast > 0 and ('Cast Time ' .. dur(cast)) or 'Instant') if num(d.chan) > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Channeling ' .. dur(d.chan)) end if num(d.cd) > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', dur(d.cd) .. ' Cooldown') end if num(d.labor) > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Labor ' .. n(num(d.labor))) end -- effects granted: the icons of the buffs; a box with the name, the effect and the facts (duration, ticks, -- stacks) opens when the pointer rests on one. An effect that needs a passive skill says so. local shown, needs = {}, {} reserve = reserve or {} for _, b in ipairs(buffs) do local f = IconName.iconFile(b.icon) if f ~= '' then local box = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buff'):attr('tabindex', tab) if b.bad then box:addClass('aa-skill-debuff') end -- a harmful effect (debuff): red frame box:wikitext('[[File:' .. f .. '|32px|link=]]') local tip = box:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip') tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname'):wikitext(esc(b.name or '')) if type(b.req) == 'table' and trim(b.req.name) ~= '' then tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-reqnote'):wikitext('Requires ' .. esc(b.req.name)) needs[#needs + 1] = b end local text = Consumable.paragraphs(holders(b.desc), 'aa-skill-bufftext') if text then tip:node(text) end local facts = {} if num(b.dur) > 0 then facts[#facts + 1] = 'Duration: ' .. dur(b.dur) end if num(b.max) > 1 and not tostring(b.desc or ''):find('Stacks up to', 1, true) then facts[#facts + 1] = 'Stacks up to ' .. n(num(b.max)) .. ' times' end for _, fact in ipairs(facts) do tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-fact'):wikitext(esc(fact)) end shown[#shown + 1] = tostring(box) end end if #shown > 0 or reserve.buffs then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep') if #shown > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Effect Granted') root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-buffs'):wikitext(table.concat(shown, ' ')) -- always visible: which passive skill the effect needs (hover for the text of the passive) for _, b in ipairs(needs) do local row = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-req'):attr('tabindex', tab) row:wikitext(pic(b.req.icon, 20)) row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-reqtext'):wikitext('Requires ' .. esc(b.req.name)) local tip = row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip') tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname'):wikitext(esc(b.req.name)) local text = Consumable.paragraphs(holders(b.req.desc), 'aa-skill-bufftext') if text then tip:node(text) end end else -- another skill of the chain has effects: the same space stays free here, so the cards look alike line(root, 'aa-skill-meta aa-skill-noeffects', 'No effects') root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-reserve aa-skill-buffspace') end end -- description: the damage placeholder becomes the formula, other unfilled ones show "(varies)" -- #{buff_tooltip}: the text of the effect of this rank (Magic Circle, Insulating Lens) local text = tostring(d.desc or '') if text:find('#{buff_tooltip}', 1, true) then local pick = '' for _, b in ipairs(buffs) do if tonumber(b.rk) then pick = tostring(b.desc or ''); break end end text = text:gsub('#{buff_tooltip}', function() return pick end) end local body = Consumable.paragraphs(holders(text, dmgText), 'aa-skill-desc') if body then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep') root:node(body) end -- combos: icon of the condition, arrow and icon of the result, then the sentence of the game if type(d.combos) == 'table' and #d.combos > 0 then local cbox = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-combobox') -- centred in the free space of a stretched card cbox:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-chainlabel'):tag('span'):wikitext('Combo') for _, c in ipairs(d.combos) do local row = cbox:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-combo') local icons = row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-comboicons') -- red frame: harmful effect (debuff), green frame: beneficial effect (buff) local function framed(icon, kind, skills, items, mounts) local span = icons:tag('span') if kind == 'bad' then span:addClass('aa-skill-ico-bad') elseif kind == 'good' then span:addClass('aa-skill-ico-good') end span:wikitext(pic(icon, 24)) -- who applies this effect: a box opens when the pointer rests on the icon. Two groups: the skills -- of the skill trees and the use effects of items (with the level of the item). local hasS = type(skills) == 'table' and #skills > 0 local hasI = type(items) == 'table' and #items > 0 local hasM = type(mounts) == 'table' and #mounts > 0 if hasS or hasI or hasM then span:addClass('aa-skill-applier'):attr('tabindex', tab) local tip = span:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip') local function group(title, list, isItem, isMount) -- isItem: grade border and item level; isMount: kinds of mount tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname aa-skill-applytitle'):wikitext(title) local anyReq = false for _, k in ipairs(list) do if type(k.req) == 'table' and trim(k.req.icon) ~= '' then anyReq = true end end for _, k in ipairs(list) do local row = tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyrow') -- gives the effect only through a combo: the effect the target needs, an arrow, then the skill if type(k.req) == 'table' and trim(k.req.icon) ~= '' then row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyneed'):wikitext(pic(k.req.icon, 20)) row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow'):wikitext('→') elseif anyReq then -- no requirement: empty space of the same width, so the icons line up row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyneed aa-skill-applygap'):wikitext(pic(list[1].icon, 20)) row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow aa-skill-applygap'):wikitext('→') end if isItem then -- the icon of the item with the border of its grade row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyicon aa-skill-applyitem'):wikitext( IconName.icon({ args = { k.name, trim(k.grade), size = 20, file = k.icon } })) else row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyicon'):wikitext(pic(k.icon, 20)) end row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyname'):wikitext(esc(k.name)) local right = isItem and (num(k.lvl) > 0 and ('Lv ' .. n(num(k.lvl))) or '') or trim(k.line) if isMount and type(k.kinds) == 'table' and #k.kinds > 0 then -- the kinds of mount that have the skill (Horse, Elk ...) right = (#k.kinds > 2) and (#k.kinds .. ' kinds') or table.concat(k.kinds, ', ') end if right ~= '' then row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyline'):wikitext(esc(right)) end -- a note under the row (Chain Lightning Wave hits only the enemies around the target) if trim(k.note) ~= '' then tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applysub aa-skill-applynote'):wikitext(esc(k.note)) end -- a few of the mounts, then how many more if isMount and type(k.ex) == 'table' and #k.ex > 0 then local more = num(k.n) - #k.ex tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applysub'):wikitext( esc(table.concat(k.ex, ', ')) .. (more > 0 and (' +' .. more .. ' more') or '')) end end end if hasS then group('Skills', skills, false) end if hasI then group('Items', items, true) end if hasM then group('Mounts', mounts, false, true) end end end if trim(c.ci) ~= '' then framed(c.ci, c.ck, c.ap, c.ai, c.am) end if trim(c.ci) ~= '' and trim(c.ri) ~= '' then icons:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow'):wikitext('→') end if trim(c.ri) ~= '' then framed(c.ri, c.rk) end row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-combotext'):wikitext(esc(holders(c.desc))) end end -- chain: the skills that follow each other; the one shown is outlined, a click on another opens its card if type(d.chain) == 'table' and #d.chain > 1 then local box = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-chainbox') -- sits at the bottom of the card box:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-chainlabel'):tag('span'):wikitext('Chain') local chain = box:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-chain') -- the icons get smaller the longer the chain is, so that the row stays inside the card (294px inside): -- n icons (+ 2px frame) and n - 1 arrows of about 24px. Very long chains wrap onto a second row. local count = #d.chain local size = math.max(18, math.min(40, math.floor((294 - (count - 1) * 24) / count) - 2)) for i, c in ipairs(d.chain) do if i > 1 then chain:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow'):wikitext('→') end local step = chain:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-step') local icon = '[[File:' .. IconName.iconFile(c.icon) .. '|' .. size .. 'px|link=' .. ((links and links[tostring(c.id)] and tostring(c.id) ~= tostring(id)) and ('#' .. setId .. 'v' .. ctx.v .. 'k' .. i) or '') .. ']]' if tostring(c.id) == tostring(id) then step:addClass('aa-skill-current') end step:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-stepicon'):wikitext(IconName.iconFile(c.icon) ~= '' and icon or '') step:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-steplabel'):wikitext(ordinal(i)) end end return root end local function render(a) -- Module:Skilltree gives the ranks and the numbers it knows for some skills (a.ranks[id], a.ovs[id]): the rank shown -- in the title and the numbers (mana, range, cast time, damage ...) that replace the stored ones. Any card of the set -- (version, chain) with an entry of its own gets them; the other cards show no rank, as the stored one is not the skill's. local function prep(x, id) if not x or (not a.ranks and not a.ovs) then return x end local c = {} for k, v in pairs(x) do c[k] = v end c.rank = a.ranks and a.ranks[tonumber(id)] or nil local ov = a.ovs and a.ovs[tonumber(id)] if ov then for k, v in pairs(ov) do c[k] = v end end return c end local function fetch(id) return prep(Store.get('SkillCards', id), id) end local d = prep(data(a), a.id) if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then return '<!-- Skill: no data, the API request failed or the skill id is wrong -->' end local float = trim(a.float):lower() if not FLOATS[float] then float = '' end local MAXV, MAXK = 6, 10 -- the styles have rules for this many versions and chain cards local wid = tostring(a.id) -- the versions of the skill (Basic, Quake ...): each has its own chain; a skill without versions is just one local versions = {} if type(d.vars) == 'table' and #d.vars > 1 then for _, w in ipairs(d.vars) do if #versions < MAXV then local wd = tostring(w.id) == wid and d or fetch(w.id) if wd then versions[#versions + 1] = { id = w.id, elem = w.elem or wd.elem or '', d = wd } end end end end local mainV for idx, w in ipairs(versions) do if tostring(w.id) == wid then mainV = idx end for _, c in ipairs(type(w.d.chain) == 'table' and w.d.chain or {}) do if tostring(c.id) == wid then mainV = idx end end end if not mainV or #versions < 2 then versions = { { id = a.id, elem = d.elem or '', d = d } } mainV = 1 end -- an item that raises the rank of a skill by 1 (rankitem in the data: Fantasia of Sorcery, Insulating Lens): one more -- card, the same skill one rank higher; it is not in the list of versions but opened by the button with the item -- icon. Only when the rank of the skill is known (Module:Skilltree gives it). local boostOf for idx, w in ipairs(versions) do local ri = type(w.d.rankitem) == 'table' and w.d.rankitem or nil local r = a.ranks and tonumber(a.ranks[tonumber(w.id)]) if ri and r and not w.boost and not boostOf and #versions < MAXV then local c = {} for k, v in pairs(w.d) do c[k] = v end c.rank = r + (tonumber(ri.plus) or 1) local ov = a.ovs and a.ovs[tonumber(w.id)] if ov and type(ov.boost) == 'table' then for k, v in pairs(ov.boost) do c[k] = v end end versions[#versions + 1] = { id = w.id, elem = w.elem, d = c, boost = true, base = idx, rank = c.rank, item = ri } w.boosted, w.item = #versions, ri boostOf = idx end end -- the cards of every version: the stored skills of its chain (position k in the chain) for idx, w in ipairs(versions) do w.idx = idx w.cards, w.links = {}, nil local chain = (not w.boost and type(w.d.chain) == 'table') and w.d.chain or {} if #chain > 1 then local links = {} for k, c in ipairs(chain) do if k <= MAXK then local cd = tostring(c.id) == wid and d or fetch(c.id) if cd then links[tostring(c.id)] = cd w.cards[#w.cards + 1] = { k = k, id = c.id, d = cd } end end end if #w.cards > 1 then w.links = links else w.cards = {} end end if #w.cards == 0 then w.cards[1] = { k = 1, id = (idx == mainV) and a.id or w.id, d = (idx == mainV) and d or w.d } end if w.boost then w.cards[1] = { k = 1, id = w.id, d = w.d } end -- does a skill of the chain have effects? Then every card of the chain keeps that space if w.links then w.reserve = {} for _, cd in pairs(w.links) do for _, b in ipairs(cd.buffs or {}) do if IconName.iconFile(b.icon) ~= '' then w.reserve.buffs = true end end end end end -- is anything to switch? (a chain or several versions); otherwise a plain card local setId = nil if #versions > 1 or versions[1].links then setId = 'aa-skill' .. wid .. <pre><code>local p = {}

-- In-game style card for a skill: icon, skill line, name, element and rank, mana, range, cast time, cooldown,
-- effects granted (buff icons), the description, the damage formula, combos and the chain it belongs to. Data: Module:Data/SkillCards/... (sync_wiki_data.py), or live from the APIs.
-- The hover boxes of mount, glider and pet skills (Module:Mount) are a different thing and stay as they are.
local IconName = require('Module:IconName')
local Store = require('Module:DataStore')
local Consumable = require('Module:Consumable')

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

local FLOATS = {
	right = 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 0.5em 1em;',
	left = 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 1em 0.5em 0;',
	center = 'margin:0 auto 0.5em auto;',
}

local function fetched(s)
	s = trim(s)
	if s:find('class="error"', 1, true) then return '' end
	return s
end

local function num(v)
	v = tonumber(v)
	if not v then return 0 end
	return v
end

local function n(x)
	if x == math.floor(x) then return string.format('%d', x) end
	return string.format('%.1f', x)
end

-- 24000 -> "24sec", 90000 -> "1min 30sec", 900000 -> "15min"
local function dur(ms)
	local total = num(ms) / 1000
	local m = math.floor(total / 60)
	local s = total - m * 60
	local out = {}
	if m > 0 then out[#out + 1] = m .. 'min' end
	if s > 0 or m == 0 then out[#out + 1] = n(s) .. 'sec' end
	return table.concat(out, ' ')
end

-- Unfilled placeholders of the game text. #{avg_damage}#{detail_melee_damage} (two in a row) is the damage: the game
-- shows "2180 (0 + 267% Melee Attack)", here the formula "(260% Melee Attack)" in green. Others show "(varies)".
local function holders(s, formulaText)
	s = tostring(s or '')
	-- no thousands separators (2,493 -> 2493), so the numbers look the same on every card
	repeat
		local before = s
		s = s:gsub('(%d),(%d%d%d)', '%1%2')
		if s == before then break end
	until false
	-- the damage of the skill: #{avg_damage}#{detail_spell_damage} or #{buff_total_avg_damage}#{detail_spell_damage}
	s = s:gsub('#%b{}%s*#{detail_[%w_]+}', function()
		return formulaText and ('|cFF6FD16F(' .. formulaText .. ')|r') or '(varies)'
	end)
	local prev
	repeat
		prev = s
		s = s:gsub('(#%b{})%s*%-?%s*#%b{}', '%1')      -- #{a}#{b} and #{min}-#{max}: one value
	until s == prev
	return (s:gsub('#%b{}', function(token)
		if formulaText and token == '#{avg_damage}' then return '|cFF6FD16F(' .. formulaText .. ')|r' end
		-- a total that is not the damage formula (damage over time of a buff): the number is not known
		return '(varies)'
	end))
end

-- 260 -> "260", 0.5 -> "0.5"
local function g(x)
	x = tonumber(x) or 0
	if x == math.floor(x) then return string.format('%d', x) end
	return (string.format('%.2f', x):gsub('0+$', ''))
end

-- the damage formula as the data gives it: "0 + 260% Melee Attack" or "18-30 + 290% Melee Attack"
local function formula(list)
	local parts = {}
	for _, x in ipairs(type(list) == 'table' and list or {}) do
		local text = g(x.pct) .. '% ' .. trim(x.stat ~= nil and x.stat or 'Attack')
		if x.fmax ~= nil then   -- the flat part, also when it is 0: "(0 + 267% Melee Attack)"
			local flat = g(x.fmin)
			if num(x.fmax) ~= num(x.fmin) then flat = flat .. '-' .. g(x.fmax) end
			text = flat .. ' + ' .. text
		end
		if x.lvl then text = text .. ', scales with level' end
		parts[#parts + 1] = text
	end
	if #parts == 0 then return nil end
	return table.concat(parts, ' + ')
end

-- small icon of the wiki (an effect, a skill)
local function pic(icon, size)
	local f = IconName.iconFile(icon)
	if f == '' then return '' end
	return '[[File:' .. f .. '|' .. size .. 'px|link=]]'
end

-- 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th ... 11th, 21st
local function ordinal(i)
	local last, teen = i % 10, i % 100
	local suffix = 'th'
	if teen < 11 or teen > 13 then
		suffix = (last == 1 and 'st') or (last == 2 and 'nd') or (last == 3 and 'rd') or 'th'
	end
	return i .. suffix
end

-- data of the card: stored, or built from the live arguments of Template:Skill
local function data(a)
	local d = Store.get('SkillCards', a.id)
	if d then return d end
	local name = fetched(a.name)
	if name == '' then return nil end
	return { name = name, icon = fetched(a.icon), line = fetched(a.line), desc = fetched(a.desc),
		cd = num(fetched(a.cd)), cast = num(fetched(a.cast)), mana = num(fetched(a.mana)),
		minr = num(fetched(a.minr)), maxr = num(fetched(a.maxr)), rad = num(fetched(a.rad)),
		labor = num(fetched(a.labor)) }
end

-- one line of the box
local function line(root, class, text)
	root:tag('div'):addClass(class):wikitext(text)
end

-- Effects with ranks (Magic Circle Rank 1 ... Rank 5): the data keeps all of them (rk = the rank); a card shows the
-- one of its rank, or when the rank is unknown the lowest. A rank that does not exist: the closest lower one.
local function ranked(buffs, want)
	local t = tonumber(want) or 1
	local function score(r)
		if r <= t then return t - r end
		return 1000 + (r - t)
	end
	local out, pos = {}, {}
	for _, b in ipairs(type(buffs) == 'table' and buffs or {}) do
		if not tonumber(b.rk) then
			out[#out + 1] = b
		else
			local key = tostring(b.icon) .. '|' .. trim((tostring(b.name or ''):gsub('%s*%(?[Rr]ank %d+%)?%s*$', '')))
			local i = pos[key]
			if not i then
				out[#out + 1] = b
				pos[key] = #out
			elseif score(tonumber(b.rk)) < score(tonumber(out[i].rk)) then
				out[i] = b
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- one card. id: the skill ID. ctx (only for a skill with a chain or versions): setId (prefix of the anchor ids),
-- v (number of the version shown), k (position of the card in its chain), links (chain skills whose card can be
-- opened, by id), reserve, vers (the versions: idx, elem), pick(w) (the position to open in version w)
local function build(d, id, a, ctx)
	ctx = ctx or {}
	local setId, links, reserve = ctx.setId, ctx.links, ctx.reserve
	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-skill')
	-- in a skill tree the icons of the card are not focusable (their boxes open on hover): a click inside the card then keeps the
	-- focus on the tile, so the card stays open and the rest of the tree stays locked. (A plain card keeps them, for touch and keyboard.)
	local tab = (not a.tileicon) and '0' or nil
	local dmgText = formula(d.dmg)
	local buffs = ranked(d.buffs, ctx.rank or (a.ranks and a.ranks[tonumber(id)] or nil))
	-- the tree can give the duration (ms) a buff really has at the shown rank, by buff name (the tree data writes seconds: bdur = { ['Ice Shard'] = 6.2 })
	if type(d.bdur) == 'table' and type(buffs) == 'table' then
		local nb = {}
		for i, b in ipairs(buffs) do
			local c = {}
			for k, v in pairs(b) do c[k] = v end
			if d.bdur[c.name] then c.dur = d.bdur[c.name] end
			nb[i] = c
		end
		buffs = nb
	end
	-- an effect that needs a passive (Mana Fountain: Requires Mana Flurry) goes first, so its requirement line sits under it
	do
		local first, rest = {}, {}
		for _, b in ipairs(buffs) do
			if type(b.req) == 'table' and trim(b.req.name) ~= '' then first[#first + 1] = b else rest[#rest + 1] = b end
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(rest) do first[#first + 1] = b end
		buffs = first
	end

	-- header: icon, skill line, name (with the rank, like the game); at the right the element (Quake, Life ...)
	local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-head')
	local file = IconName.iconFile(d.icon)
	if file ~= '' then
		head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-icon'):wikitext('[[File:' .. file .. '|48px|link=]]')
	end
	local title = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-title')
	if trim(d.line) ~= '' then title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-line'):wikitext(esc(d.line)) end
	local name = trim(d.name)
	if num(d.rank) > 0 then name = name .. ' (Rank ' .. n(num(d.rank)) .. ')' end
	title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-name'):wikitext(esc(name))
	-- an item that raises the rank of the skill (Fantasia of Sorcery): its icon is a switch between the card and the same
	-- card one rank higher (rank and effect of that rank); left of the versions, so those stay where they are
	if ctx.boostBtn and IconName.iconFile(ctx.boostBtn.item.icon) ~= '' then
		local bb = ctx.boostBtn
		local plus = tonumber(bb.item.plus) or 1
		local btn = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-boost')
		if bb.on then btn:addClass('aa-skill-boost-on') end
		btn:wikitext('[[File:' .. IconName.iconFile(bb.item.icon) .. '|30px|link=#' .. bb.target .. ']]')
		local tip = btn:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip')
		tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname'):wikitext(esc(bb.item.name))
		tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftext'):wikitext('Increases the rank of ' .. esc(trim(d.name)) .. ' by +' .. n(plus) ..
			'. ' .. (bb.on and 'Click to switch it off.' or 'Click to switch it on.'))
	end

	local nvers = 0
	for _, w in ipairs(ctx.vers or {}) do
		if not w.boost then nvers = nvers + 1 end      -- (the card with the rank item is not a version)
	end
	if nvers > 1 then
		-- the versions of the skill (Basic, Quake, Lightning ...): the shown one is bold, a click on another opens it
		local tag = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-tag')
		for _, w in ipairs(ctx.vers) do
			if not w.boost then
				local item = tag:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-elem')
				if w.idx == (ctx.vcur or ctx.v) then
					item:addClass('aa-skill-elem-cur'):wikitext(esc(w.elem))
				else
					item:addClass('aa-skill-elem-alt'):wikitext('[[#' .. setId .. 'v' .. w.idx .. 'k' .. ctx.pick(w) .. '|' .. esc(w.elem) .. ']]')
				end
			end
		end
	elseif trim(d.elem) ~= '' then
		head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-tag'):tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-elem'):wikitext(esc(d.elem))
	end

	-- mana, range, effect range, attack percent (only what the data has)
	local mana, maxr, rad = num(d.mana), num(d.maxr), num(d.rad)
	local first = type(d.dmg) == 'table' and d.dmg[1] or nil
	if mana > 0 or maxr > 0 or rad > 0 or first or d.caster or d.charges then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep')
		if d.charges then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta aa-skill-orange', 'Abyssal Charges ' .. esc(d.charges)) end
		if mana > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Mana ' .. n(mana)) end
		if d.caster then
			line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Range: Caster only')
		elseif maxr > 0 then
			line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Range: ' .. n(num(d.minr)) .. '-' .. n(maxr) .. ' m')
		end
		if rad > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Effect Range: ' .. n(rad) .. ' m') end
		if first then
			line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', esc(trim(first.stat ~= nil and first.stat or 'Attack') .. ' +' .. g(first.pct) .. '%'))
		end
	end

	-- cast time, cooldown, channeling, labor
	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep')
	local cast = num(d.cast)
	line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', cast > 0 and ('Cast Time ' .. dur(cast)) or 'Instant')
	if num(d.chan) > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Channeling ' .. dur(d.chan)) end
	if num(d.cd) > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', dur(d.cd) .. ' Cooldown') end
	if num(d.labor) > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Labor ' .. n(num(d.labor))) end

	-- effects granted: the icons of the buffs; a box with the name, the effect and the facts (duration, ticks,
	-- stacks) opens when the pointer rests on one. An effect that needs a passive skill says so.
	local shown, needs = {}, {}
	reserve = reserve or {}
	for _, b in ipairs(buffs) do
		local f = IconName.iconFile(b.icon)
		if f ~= '' then
			local box = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buff'):attr('tabindex', tab)
			if b.bad then box:addClass('aa-skill-debuff') end   -- a harmful effect (debuff): red frame
			box:wikitext('[[File:' .. f .. '|32px|link=]]')
			local tip = box:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip')
			tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname'):wikitext(esc(b.name or ''))
			if type(b.req) == 'table' and trim(b.req.name) ~= '' then
				tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-reqnote'):wikitext('Requires ' .. esc(b.req.name))
				needs[#needs + 1] = b
			end
			local text = Consumable.paragraphs(holders(b.desc), 'aa-skill-bufftext')
			if text then tip:node(text) end
			local facts = {}
			if num(b.dur) > 0 then facts[#facts + 1] = 'Duration: ' .. dur(b.dur) end
			if num(b.max) > 1 and not tostring(b.desc or ''):find('Stacks up to', 1, true) then
				facts[#facts + 1] = 'Stacks up to ' .. n(num(b.max)) .. ' times'
			end
			for _, fact in ipairs(facts) do tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-fact'):wikitext(esc(fact)) end
			shown[#shown + 1] = tostring(box)
		end
	end
	if #shown > 0 or reserve.buffs then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep')
		if #shown > 0 then
			line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Effect Granted')
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-buffs'):wikitext(table.concat(shown, ' '))
			-- always visible: which passive skill the effect needs (hover for the text of the passive)
			for _, b in ipairs(needs) do
				local row = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-req'):attr('tabindex', tab)
				row:wikitext(pic(b.req.icon, 20))
				row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-reqtext'):wikitext('Requires ' .. esc(b.req.name))
				local tip = row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip')
				tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname'):wikitext(esc(b.req.name))
				local text = Consumable.paragraphs(holders(b.req.desc), 'aa-skill-bufftext')
				if text then tip:node(text) end
			end
		else
			-- another skill of the chain has effects: the same space stays free here, so the cards look alike
			line(root, 'aa-skill-meta aa-skill-noeffects', 'No effects')
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-reserve aa-skill-buffspace')
		end
	end

	-- description: the damage placeholder becomes the formula, other unfilled ones show "(varies)"
	-- #{buff_tooltip}: the text of the effect of this rank (Magic Circle, Insulating Lens)
	local text = tostring(d.desc or '')
	if text:find('#{buff_tooltip}', 1, true) then
		local pick = ''
		for _, b in ipairs(buffs) do
			if tonumber(b.rk) then pick = tostring(b.desc or ''); break end
		end
		text = text:gsub('#{buff_tooltip}', function() return pick end)
	end
	local body = Consumable.paragraphs(holders(text, dmgText), 'aa-skill-desc')
	if body then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep')
		root:node(body)
	end

	-- combos: icon of the condition, arrow and icon of the result, then the sentence of the game
	if type(d.combos) == 'table' and #d.combos > 0 then
		local cbox = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-combobox')   -- centred in the free space of a stretched card
		cbox:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-chainlabel'):tag('span'):wikitext('Combo')
		for _, c in ipairs(d.combos) do
			local row = cbox:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-combo')
			local icons = row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-comboicons')
			-- red frame: harmful effect (debuff), green frame: beneficial effect (buff)
			local function framed(icon, kind, skills, items, mounts)
				local span = icons:tag('span')
				if kind == 'bad' then span:addClass('aa-skill-ico-bad') elseif kind == 'good' then span:addClass('aa-skill-ico-good') end
				span:wikitext(pic(icon, 24))
				-- who applies this effect: a box opens when the pointer rests on the icon. Two groups: the skills
				-- of the skill trees and the use effects of items (with the level of the item).
				local hasS = type(skills) == 'table' and #skills > 0
				local hasI = type(items) == 'table' and #items > 0
				local hasM = type(mounts) == 'table' and #mounts > 0
				if hasS or hasI or hasM then
					span:addClass('aa-skill-applier'):attr('tabindex', tab)
					local tip = span:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip')
					local function group(title, list, isItem, isMount)   -- isItem: grade border and item level; isMount: kinds of mount
						tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname aa-skill-applytitle'):wikitext(title)
						local anyReq = false
						for _, k in ipairs(list) do
							if type(k.req) == 'table' and trim(k.req.icon) ~= '' then anyReq = true end
						end
						for _, k in ipairs(list) do
							local row = tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyrow')
							-- gives the effect only through a combo: the effect the target needs, an arrow, then the skill
							if type(k.req) == 'table' and trim(k.req.icon) ~= '' then
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyneed'):wikitext(pic(k.req.icon, 20))
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow'):wikitext('&rarr;')
							elseif anyReq then
								-- no requirement: empty space of the same width, so the icons line up
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyneed aa-skill-applygap'):wikitext(pic(list[1].icon, 20))
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow aa-skill-applygap'):wikitext('&rarr;')
							end
							if isItem then
								-- the icon of the item with the border of its grade
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyicon aa-skill-applyitem'):wikitext(
									IconName.icon({ args = { k.name, trim(k.grade), size = 20, file = k.icon } }))
							else
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyicon'):wikitext(pic(k.icon, 20))
							end
							row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyname'):wikitext(esc(k.name))
							local right = isItem and (num(k.lvl) > 0 and ('Lv ' .. n(num(k.lvl))) or '') or trim(k.line)
							if isMount and type(k.kinds) == 'table' and #k.kinds > 0 then
								-- the kinds of mount that have the skill (Horse, Elk ...)
								right = (#k.kinds > 2) and (#k.kinds .. ' kinds') or table.concat(k.kinds, ', ')
							end
							if right ~= '' then row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyline'):wikitext(esc(right)) end
							-- a note under the row (Chain Lightning Wave hits only the enemies around the target)
							if trim(k.note) ~= '' then
								tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applysub aa-skill-applynote'):wikitext(esc(k.note))
							end
							-- a few of the mounts, then how many more
							if isMount and type(k.ex) == 'table' and #k.ex > 0 then
								local more = num(k.n) - #k.ex
								tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applysub'):wikitext(
									esc(table.concat(k.ex, ', ')) .. (more > 0 and (' +' .. more .. ' more') or ''))
							end
						end
					end

local function render(a)

	-- in the title and the numbers (mana, range, cast time, damage ...) that replace the stored ones. Any card of the set
	-- (version, chain) with an entry of its own gets them; the other cards show no rank, as the stored one is not the skill's.
	local function prep(x, id)
		if not x or (not a.ranks and not a.ovs) then return x end
		local c = {}
		for k, v in pairs(x) do c[k] = v end
		c.rank = a.ranks and a.ranks[tonumber(id)] or nil
		local ov = a.ovs and a.ovs[tonumber(id)]
		if ov then
			for k, v in pairs(ov) do c[k] = v end
		end
		return c
	end
	local function fetch(id)
		return prep(Store.get('SkillCards', id), id)
	end

	if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then
		return '<!-- Skill: no data, the API request failed or the skill id is wrong -->'
	end

	local float = trim(a.float):lower()
	if not FLOATS[float] then float = '' end

	local MAXV, MAXK = 6, 10   -- the styles have rules for this many versions and chain cards
	local wid = tostring(a.id)

	-- the versions of the skill (Basic, Quake ...): each has its own chain; a skill without versions is just one
	local versions = {}
	if type(d.vars) == 'table' and #d.vars > 1 then
		for _, w in ipairs(d.vars) do
			if #versions < MAXV then
				local wd = tostring(w.id) == wid and d or fetch(w.id)
				if wd then versions[#versions + 1] = { id = w.id, elem = w.elem or wd.elem or '', d = wd } end
			end
		end
	end
	local mainV
	for idx, w in ipairs(versions) do
		if tostring(w.id) == wid then mainV = idx end
		for _, c in ipairs(type(w.d.chain) == 'table' and w.d.chain or {}) do
			if tostring(c.id) == wid then mainV = idx end
		end

	end

	-- card, the same skill one rank higher; it is not in the list of versions but opened by the button with the item
	-- icon. Only when the rank of the skill is known (Module:Skilltree gives it).
	local boostOf
	for idx, w in ipairs(versions) do
		local ri = type(w.d.rankitem) == 'table' and w.d.rankitem or nil
		local r = a.ranks and tonumber(a.ranks[tonumber(w.id)])
		if ri and r and not w.boost and not boostOf and #versions < MAXV then
			local c = {}
			for k, v in pairs(w.d) do c[k] = v end
			c.rank = r + (tonumber(ri.plus) or 1)
			local ov = a.ovs and a.ovs[tonumber(w.id)]
			if ov and type(ov.boost) == 'table' then
				for k, v in pairs(ov.boost) do c[k] = v end
			end
			versions[#versions + 1] = { id = w.id, elem = w.elem, d = c, boost = true, base = idx, rank = c.rank, item = ri }
			w.boosted, w.item = #versions, ri

		end

		w.idx = idx
		w.cards, w.links = {}, nil
		local chain = (not w.boost and type(w.d.chain) == 'table') and w.d.chain or {}
		if #chain > 1 then
			local links = {}
			for k, c in ipairs(chain) do
				if k <= MAXK then
					local cd = tostring(c.id) == wid and d or fetch(c.id)
					if cd then
						links[tostring(c.id)] = cd
						w.cards[#w.cards + 1] = { k = k, id = c.id, d = cd }
					end
				end
			end
			if #w.cards > 1 then w.links = links else w.cards = {} end
		end
		if #w.cards == 0 then w.cards[1] = { k = 1, id = (idx == mainV) and a.id or w.id, d = (idx == mainV) and d or w.d } end
		if w.boost then w.cards[1] = { k = 1, id = w.id, d = w.d } end
		-- does a skill of the chain have effects? Then every card of the chain keeps that space
		if w.links then
			w.reserve = {}
			for _, cd in pairs(w.links) do
				for _, b in ipairs(cd.buffs or {}) do
					if IconName.iconFile(b.icon) ~= '' then w.reserve.buffs = true end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- is anything to switch? (a chain or several versions); otherwise a plain card
	local setId = nil
	if #versions > 1 or versions[1].links then
		setId = 'aa-skill' .. wid .. '-'   -- different for every card on a page
	end

	local wrap = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-skill-set')
	if float == 'right' or float == 'left' then wrap:addClass('aa-skill-float') end
	if float == 'right' then wrap:addClass('aa-skill-right') end
	if float ~= '' then wrap:attr('style', FLOATS[float]) end

	-- for Module:Skilltree: the icon of the tile follows the card that is shown (the same :target anchors)
	local function tileIcon(parent)
		local ico = parent:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tileicons')
		ico:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ti aa-ti-main'):wikitext(pic(d.icon, 56))
		return ico
	end

	if not setId then
		if a.tileicon then tileIcon(wrap) end
		local box = wrap:tag('div'):addClass('aa-varset aa-varmain')
		box:node(build(d, a.id, a, {}):addClass('aa-skill-main'))
		return tostring(wrap)
	end

	-- the position to open in version w when the viewer comes from card k: the same step if it exists
	local function pickFor(w, k)
		local best = w.cards[1].k
		for _, c in ipairs(w.cards) do
			if c.k <= k then best = c.k end
		end
		return best
	end

	-- anchors first (the :target of the links), then one container per version
	for _, w in ipairs(versions) do
		for _, c in ipairs(w.cards) do
			wrap:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-anchor aa-pick aa-pick-v' .. w.idx .. ' aa-pick-k' .. c.k)
				:attr('id', setId .. 'v' .. w.idx .. 'k' .. c.k)
		end
	end
	if a.tileicon then
		local ico = tileIcon(wrap)
		for _, w in ipairs(versions) do
			for _, c in ipairs(w.cards) do
				ico:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ti aa-ti-v' .. w.idx .. ' aa-ti-k' .. c.k):wikitext(pic(c.d.icon, 56))
			end
		end
	end
	for _, w in ipairs(versions) do
		local box = wrap:tag('div'):addClass('aa-varset aa-varset-v' .. w.idx)
		if w.idx == mainV then box:addClass('aa-varmain') end
		for _, c in ipairs(w.cards) do
			local card = build(c.d, c.id, a, {
				setId = setId, v = w.idx, k = c.k, links = w.links, reserve = w.reserve, vers = versions,
				pick = function(o) return pickFor(o, c.k) end,
				vcur = w.boost and w.base or nil, rank = w.boost and w.rank or nil,
				boostBtn = (w.boost and { item = w.item, on = true, target = setId .. 'v' .. w.base .. 'k1' })
					or (w.boosted and { item = w.item, on = false, target = setId .. 'v' .. w.boosted .. 'k1' }) or nil,
			})
			card:addClass('aa-card-k' .. c.k)
			if w.idx == mainV and tostring(c.id) == wid then card:addClass('aa-skill-main') end
			box:node(card)
		end
	end
	return tostring(wrap)
end

local p = {}

-- In-game style card for a skill: icon, skill line, name, element and rank, mana, range, cast time, cooldown,
-- effects granted (buff icons), the description, the damage formula, combos and the chain it belongs to. Data: Module:Data/SkillCards/... (sync_wiki_data.py), or live from the APIs.
-- The hover boxes of mount, glider and pet skills (Module:Mount) are a different thing and stay as they are.
local IconName = require('Module:IconName')
local Store = require('Module:DataStore')
local Consumable = require('Module:Consumable')

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

local FLOATS = {
	right = 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 0.5em 1em;',
	left = 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 1em 0.5em 0;',
	center = 'margin:0 auto 0.5em auto;',
}

local function fetched(s)
	s = trim(s)
	if s:find('class="error"', 1, true) then return '' end
	return s
end

local function num(v)
	v = tonumber(v)
	if not v then return 0 end
	return v
end

local function n(x)
	if x == math.floor(x) then return string.format('%d', x) end
	return string.format('%.1f', x)
end

-- 24000 -> "24sec", 90000 -> "1min 30sec", 900000 -> "15min"
local function dur(ms)
	local total = num(ms) / 1000
	local m = math.floor(total / 60)
	local s = total - m * 60
	local out = {}
	if m > 0 then out[#out + 1] = m .. 'min' end
	if s > 0 or m == 0 then out[#out + 1] = n(s) .. 'sec' end
	return table.concat(out, ' ')
end

-- Unfilled placeholders of the game text. #{avg_damage}#{detail_melee_damage} (two in a row) is the damage: the game
-- shows "2180 (0 + 267% Melee Attack)", here the formula "(260% Melee Attack)" in green. Others show "(varies)".
local function holders(s, formulaText)
	s = tostring(s or '')
	-- no thousands separators (2,493 -> 2493), so the numbers look the same on every card
	repeat
		local before = s
		s = s:gsub('(%d),(%d%d%d)', '%1%2')
		if s == before then break end
	until false
	-- the damage of the skill: #{avg_damage}#{detail_spell_damage} or #{buff_total_avg_damage}#{detail_spell_damage}
	s = s:gsub('#%b{}%s*#{detail_[%w_]+}', function()
		return formulaText and ('|cFF6FD16F(' .. formulaText .. ')|r') or '(varies)'
	end)
	local prev
	repeat
		prev = s
		s = s:gsub('(#%b{})%s*%-?%s*#%b{}', '%1')      -- #{a}#{b} and #{min}-#{max}: one value
	until s == prev
	return (s:gsub('#%b{}', function(token)
		if formulaText and token == '#{avg_damage}' then return '|cFF6FD16F(' .. formulaText .. ')|r' end
		-- a total that is not the damage formula (damage over time of a buff): the number is not known
		return '(varies)'
	end))
end

-- 260 -> "260", 0.5 -> "0.5"
local function g(x)
	x = tonumber(x) or 0
	if x == math.floor(x) then return string.format('%d', x) end
	return (string.format('%.2f', x):gsub('0+$', ''))
end

-- the damage formula as the data gives it: "0 + 260% Melee Attack" or "18-30 + 290% Melee Attack"
local function formula(list)
	local parts = {}
	for _, x in ipairs(type(list) == 'table' and list or {}) do
		local text = g(x.pct) .. '% ' .. trim(x.stat ~= nil and x.stat or 'Attack')
		if x.fmax ~= nil then   -- the flat part, also when it is 0: "(0 + 267% Melee Attack)"
			local flat = g(x.fmin)
			if num(x.fmax) ~= num(x.fmin) then flat = flat .. '-' .. g(x.fmax) end
			text = flat .. ' + ' .. text
		end
		if x.lvl then text = text .. ', scales with level' end
		parts[#parts + 1] = text
	end
	if #parts == 0 then return nil end
	return table.concat(parts, ' + ')

-- 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th ... 11th, 21st
local function ordinal(i)
	local last, teen = i % 10, i % 100
	local suffix = 'th'
	if teen < 11 or teen > 13 then
		suffix = (last == 1 and 'st') or (last == 2 and 'nd') or (last == 3 and 'rd') or 'th'

-- Effects with ranks (Magic Circle Rank 1 ... Rank 5): the data keeps all of them (rk = the rank); a card shows the
-- one of its rank, or when the rank is unknown the lowest. A rank that does not exist: the closest lower one.
local function ranked(buffs, want)
	local t = tonumber(want) or 1
	local function score(r)
		if r <= t then return t - r end
		return 1000 + (r - t)
	end
	local out, pos = {}, {}
	for _, b in ipairs(type(buffs) == 'table' and buffs or {}) do
		if not tonumber(b.rk) then
			out[#out + 1] = b

			local i = pos[key]
			if not i then
				out[#out + 1] = b
				pos[key] = #out
			elseif score(tonumber(b.rk)) < score(tonumber(out[i].rk)) then
				out[i] = b
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

	if num(d.chan) > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Channeling ' .. dur(d.chan)) end
	if num(d.cd) > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', dur(d.cd) .. ' Cooldown') end
	if num(d.labor) > 0 then line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Labor ' .. n(num(d.labor))) end

	-- effects granted: the icons of the buffs; a box with the name, the effect and the facts (duration, ticks,
	-- stacks) opens when the pointer rests on one. An effect that needs a passive skill says so.
	local shown, needs = {}, {}
	reserve = reserve or {}
	for _, b in ipairs(buffs) do
		local f = IconName.iconFile(b.icon)
		if f ~= '' then
			local box = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buff'):attr('tabindex', tab)
			if b.bad then box:addClass('aa-skill-debuff') end   -- a harmful effect (debuff): red frame
			box:wikitext('[[File:' .. f .. '|32px|link=]]')
			local tip = box:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip')
			tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname'):wikitext(esc(b.name or ''))
			if type(b.req) == 'table' and trim(b.req.name) ~= '' then
				tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-reqnote'):wikitext('Requires ' .. esc(b.req.name))
				needs[#needs + 1] = b
			end
			local text = Consumable.paragraphs(holders(b.desc), 'aa-skill-bufftext')
			if text then tip:node(text) end
			local facts = {}
			if num(b.dur) > 0 then facts[#facts + 1] = 'Duration: ' .. dur(b.dur) end
			if num(b.max) > 1 and not tostring(b.desc or ''):find('Stacks up to', 1, true) then
				facts[#facts + 1] = 'Stacks up to ' .. n(num(b.max)) .. ' times'
			end
			for _, fact in ipairs(facts) do tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-fact'):wikitext(esc(fact)) end
			shown[#shown + 1] = tostring(box)
		end
	end
	if #shown > 0 or reserve.buffs then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep')
		if #shown > 0 then
			line(root, 'aa-skill-meta', 'Effect Granted')
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-buffs'):wikitext(table.concat(shown, ' '))
			-- always visible: which passive skill the effect needs (hover for the text of the passive)
			for _, b in ipairs(needs) do
				local row = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-req'):attr('tabindex', tab)
				row:wikitext(pic(b.req.icon, 20))
				row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-reqtext'):wikitext('Requires ' .. esc(b.req.name))
				local tip = row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip')
				tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname'):wikitext(esc(b.req.name))
				local text = Consumable.paragraphs(holders(b.req.desc), 'aa-skill-bufftext')
				if text then tip:node(text) end
			end
		else
			-- another skill of the chain has effects: the same space stays free here, so the cards look alike
			line(root, 'aa-skill-meta aa-skill-noeffects', 'No effects')
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-reserve aa-skill-buffspace')
		end
	end

	-- description: the damage placeholder becomes the formula, other unfilled ones show "(varies)"
	-- #{buff_tooltip}: the text of the effect of this rank (Magic Circle, Insulating Lens)
	local text = tostring(d.desc or '')
	if text:find('#{buff_tooltip}', 1, true) then
		local pick = ''
		for _, b in ipairs(buffs) do
			if tonumber(b.rk) then pick = tostring(b.desc or ''); break end
		end
		text = text:gsub('#{buff_tooltip}', function() return pick end)
	end
	local body = Consumable.paragraphs(holders(text, dmgText), 'aa-skill-desc')
	if body then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-sep')
		root:node(body)
	end

	-- combos: icon of the condition, arrow and icon of the result, then the sentence of the game
	if type(d.combos) == 'table' and #d.combos > 0 then
		local cbox = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-combobox')   -- centred in the free space of a stretched card
		cbox:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-chainlabel'):tag('span'):wikitext('Combo')
		for _, c in ipairs(d.combos) do
			local row = cbox:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-combo')
			local icons = row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-comboicons')
			-- red frame: harmful effect (debuff), green frame: beneficial effect (buff)
			local function framed(icon, kind, skills, items, mounts)
				local span = icons:tag('span')
				if kind == 'bad' then span:addClass('aa-skill-ico-bad') elseif kind == 'good' then span:addClass('aa-skill-ico-good') end
				span:wikitext(pic(icon, 24))
				-- who applies this effect: a box opens when the pointer rests on the icon. Two groups: the skills
				-- of the skill trees and the use effects of items (with the level of the item).
				local hasS = type(skills) == 'table' and #skills > 0
				local hasI = type(items) == 'table' and #items > 0
				local hasM = type(mounts) == 'table' and #mounts > 0
				if hasS or hasI or hasM then
					span:addClass('aa-skill-applier'):attr('tabindex', tab)
					local tip = span:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-bufftip')
					local function group(title, list, isItem, isMount)   -- isItem: grade border and item level; isMount: kinds of mount
						tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-buffname aa-skill-applytitle'):wikitext(title)
						local anyReq = false
						for _, k in ipairs(list) do
							if type(k.req) == 'table' and trim(k.req.icon) ~= '' then anyReq = true end
						end
						for _, k in ipairs(list) do
							local row = tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyrow')
							-- gives the effect only through a combo: the effect the target needs, an arrow, then the skill
							if type(k.req) == 'table' and trim(k.req.icon) ~= '' then
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyneed'):wikitext(pic(k.req.icon, 20))
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow'):wikitext('→')
							elseif anyReq then
								-- no requirement: empty space of the same width, so the icons line up
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyneed aa-skill-applygap'):wikitext(pic(list[1].icon, 20))
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow aa-skill-applygap'):wikitext('→')
							end
							if isItem then
								-- the icon of the item with the border of its grade
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyicon aa-skill-applyitem'):wikitext(
									IconName.icon({ args = { k.name, trim(k.grade), size = 20, file = k.icon } }))
							else
								row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyicon'):wikitext(pic(k.icon, 20))
							end
							row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyname'):wikitext(esc(k.name))
							local right = isItem and (num(k.lvl) > 0 and ('Lv ' .. n(num(k.lvl))) or '') or trim(k.line)
							if isMount and type(k.kinds) == 'table' and #k.kinds > 0 then
								-- the kinds of mount that have the skill (Horse, Elk ...)
								right = (#k.kinds > 2) and (#k.kinds .. ' kinds') or table.concat(k.kinds, ', ')
							end
							if right ~= '' then row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applyline'):wikitext(esc(right)) end
							-- a note under the row (Chain Lightning Wave hits only the enemies around the target)
							if trim(k.note) ~= '' then
								tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applysub aa-skill-applynote'):wikitext(esc(k.note))
							end
							-- a few of the mounts, then how many more
							if isMount and type(k.ex) == 'table' and #k.ex > 0 then
								local more = num(k.n) - #k.ex
								tip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-applysub'):wikitext(
									esc(table.concat(k.ex, ', ')) .. (more > 0 and (' +' .. more .. ' more') or ''))
							end
						end
					end
					if hasS then group('Skills', skills, false) end
					if hasI then group('Items', items, true) end
					if hasM then group('Mounts', mounts, false, true) end
				end
			end
			if trim(c.ci) ~= '' then framed(c.ci, c.ck, c.ap, c.ai, c.am) end
			if trim(c.ci) ~= '' and trim(c.ri) ~= '' then icons:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow'):wikitext('→') end
			if trim(c.ri) ~= '' then framed(c.ri, c.rk) end
			row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-combotext'):wikitext(esc(holders(c.desc)))
		end
	end

	-- chain: the skills that follow each other; the one shown is outlined, a click on another opens its card
	if type(d.chain) == 'table' and #d.chain > 1 then
		local box = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-chainbox')   -- sits at the bottom of the card
		box:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-chainlabel'):tag('span'):wikitext('Chain')
		local chain = box:tag('div'):addClass('aa-skill-chain')
		-- the icons get smaller the longer the chain is, so that the row stays inside the card (294px inside):
		-- n icons (+ 2px frame) and n - 1 arrows of about 24px. Very long chains wrap onto a second row.
		local count = #d.chain
		local size = math.max(18, math.min(40, math.floor((294 - (count - 1) * 24) / count) - 2))
		for i, c in ipairs(d.chain) do
			if i > 1 then chain:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-arrow'):wikitext('→') end
			local step = chain:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-step')
			local icon = '[[File:' .. IconName.iconFile(c.icon) .. '|' .. size .. 'px|link=' ..
				((links and links[tostring(c.id)] and tostring(c.id) ~= tostring(id)) and ('#' .. setId .. 'v' .. ctx.v .. 'k' .. i) or '') .. ']]'
			if tostring(c.id) == tostring(id) then step:addClass('aa-skill-current') end
			step:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-stepicon'):wikitext(IconName.iconFile(c.icon) ~= '' and icon or '')
			step:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-steplabel'):wikitext(ordinal(i))
		end
	end
	return root
end

local function render(a)
	-- Module:Skilltree gives the ranks and the numbers it knows for some skills (a.ranks[id], a.ovs[id]): the rank shown
	-- in the title and the numbers (mana, range, cast time, damage ...) that replace the stored ones. Any card of the set
	-- (version, chain) with an entry of its own gets them; the other cards show no rank, as the stored one is not the skill's.
	local function prep(x, id)
		if not x or (not a.ranks and not a.ovs) then return x end
		local c = {}
		for k, v in pairs(x) do c[k] = v end
		c.rank = a.ranks and a.ranks[tonumber(id)] or nil
		local ov = a.ovs and a.ovs[tonumber(id)]
		if ov then
			for k, v in pairs(ov) do c[k] = v end
		end
		return c
	end
	local function fetch(id)
		return prep(Store.get('SkillCards', id), id)
	end
	local d = prep(data(a), a.id)
	if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then
		return '<!-- Skill: no data, the API request failed or the skill id is wrong -->'
	end

	local float = trim(a.float):lower()
	if not FLOATS[float] then float = '' end

	local MAXV, MAXK = 6, 10   -- the styles have rules for this many versions and chain cards
	local wid = tostring(a.id)

	-- the versions of the skill (Basic, Quake ...): each has its own chain; a skill without versions is just one
	local versions = {}
	if type(d.vars) == 'table' and #d.vars > 1 then
		for _, w in ipairs(d.vars) do
			if #versions < MAXV then
				local wd = tostring(w.id) == wid and d or fetch(w.id)
				if wd then versions[#versions + 1] = { id = w.id, elem = w.elem or wd.elem or '', d = wd } end
			end
		end
	end
	local mainV
	for idx, w in ipairs(versions) do
		if tostring(w.id) == wid then mainV = idx end
		for _, c in ipairs(type(w.d.chain) == 'table' and w.d.chain or {}) do
			if tostring(c.id) == wid then mainV = idx end
		end
	end
	if not mainV or #versions < 2 then
		versions = { { id = a.id, elem = d.elem or '', d = d } }
		mainV = 1
	end

	-- an item that raises the rank of a skill by 1 (rankitem in the data: Fantasia of Sorcery, Insulating Lens): one more
	-- card, the same skill one rank higher; it is not in the list of versions but opened by the button with the item
	-- icon. Only when the rank of the skill is known (Module:Skilltree gives it).
	local boostOf
	for idx, w in ipairs(versions) do
		local ri = type(w.d.rankitem) == 'table' and w.d.rankitem or nil
		local r = a.ranks and tonumber(a.ranks[tonumber(w.id)])
		if ri and r and not w.boost and not boostOf and #versions < MAXV then
			local c = {}
			for k, v in pairs(w.d) do c[k] = v end
			c.rank = r + (tonumber(ri.plus) or 1)
			local ov = a.ovs and a.ovs[tonumber(w.id)]
			if ov and type(ov.boost) == 'table' then
				for k, v in pairs(ov.boost) do c[k] = v end
			end
			versions[#versions + 1] = { id = w.id, elem = w.elem, d = c, boost = true, base = idx, rank = c.rank, item = ri }
			w.boosted, w.item = #versions, ri
			boostOf = idx
		end
	end

	-- the cards of every version: the stored skills of its chain (position k in the chain)
	for idx, w in ipairs(versions) do
		w.idx = idx
		w.cards, w.links = {}, nil
		local chain = (not w.boost and type(w.d.chain) == 'table') and w.d.chain or {}
		if #chain > 1 then
			local links = {}
			for k, c in ipairs(chain) do
				if k <= MAXK then
					local cd = tostring(c.id) == wid and d or fetch(c.id)
					if cd then
						links[tostring(c.id)] = cd
						w.cards[#w.cards + 1] = { k = k, id = c.id, d = cd }
					end
				end
			end
			if #w.cards > 1 then w.links = links else w.cards = {} end
		end
		if #w.cards == 0 then w.cards[1] = { k = 1, id = (idx == mainV) and a.id or w.id, d = (idx == mainV) and d or w.d } end
		if w.boost then w.cards[1] = { k = 1, id = w.id, d = w.d } end
		-- does a skill of the chain have effects? Then every card of the chain keeps that space
		if w.links then
			w.reserve = {}
			for _, cd in pairs(w.links) do
				for _, b in ipairs(cd.buffs or {}) do
					if IconName.iconFile(b.icon) ~= '' then w.reserve.buffs = true end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- is anything to switch? (a chain or several versions); otherwise a plain card
	local setId = nil
	if #versions > 1 or versions[1].links then
		setId = 'aa-skill' .. wid .. '-'   -- different for every card on a page
	end

	local wrap = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-skill-set')
	if float == 'right' or float == 'left' then wrap:addClass('aa-skill-float') end
	if float == 'right' then wrap:addClass('aa-skill-right') end
	if float ~= '' then wrap:attr('style', FLOATS[float]) end

	-- for Module:Skilltree: the icon of the tile follows the card that is shown (the same :target anchors)
	local function tileIcon(parent)
		local ico = parent:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tileicons')
		ico:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ti aa-ti-main'):wikitext(pic(d.icon, 56))
		return ico
	end

	if not setId then
		if a.tileicon then tileIcon(wrap) end
		local box = wrap:tag('div'):addClass('aa-varset aa-varmain')
		box:node(build(d, a.id, a, {}):addClass('aa-skill-main'))
		return tostring(wrap)
	end

	-- the position to open in version w when the viewer comes from card k: the same step if it exists
	local function pickFor(w, k)
		local best = w.cards[1].k
		for _, c in ipairs(w.cards) do
			if c.k <= k then best = c.k end
		end
		return best
	end

	-- anchors first (the :target of the links), then one container per version
	for _, w in ipairs(versions) do
		for _, c in ipairs(w.cards) do
			wrap:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skill-anchor aa-pick aa-pick-v' .. w.idx .. ' aa-pick-k' .. c.k)
				:attr('id', setId .. 'v' .. w.idx .. 'k' .. c.k)
		end
	end
	if a.tileicon then
		local ico = tileIcon(wrap)
		for _, w in ipairs(versions) do
			for _, c in ipairs(w.cards) do
				ico:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ti aa-ti-v' .. w.idx .. ' aa-ti-k' .. c.k):wikitext(pic(c.d.icon, 56))
			end
		end
	end
	for _, w in ipairs(versions) do
		local box = wrap:tag('div'):addClass('aa-varset aa-varset-v' .. w.idx)
		if w.idx == mainV then box:addClass('aa-varmain') end
		for _, c in ipairs(w.cards) do
			local card = build(c.d, c.id, a, {
				setId = setId, v = w.idx, k = c.k, links = w.links, reserve = w.reserve, vers = versions,
				pick = function(o) return pickFor(o, c.k) end,
				vcur = w.boost and w.base or nil, rank = w.boost and w.rank or nil,
				boostBtn = (w.boost and { item = w.item, on = true, target = setId .. 'v' .. w.base .. 'k1' })
					or (w.boosted and { item = w.item, on = false, target = setId .. 'v' .. w.boosted .. 'k1' }) or nil,
			})
			card:addClass('aa-card-k' .. c.k)
			if w.idx == mainV and tostring(c.id) == wid then card:addClass('aa-skill-main') end
			box:node(card)
		end
	end
	return tostring(wrap)
end

function p.card(frame)
	return render(frame.args)
end

-- {{#invoke:Skill|link|id=10667}}: the small icon (32px) and the name of a stored skill, for Template:SkillLink (nothing when not stored)
function p.link(frame)
	local d = Store.get('SkillCards', frame.args.id)
	if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then return '' end
	local name = trim((tostring(d.name):gsub('%s*%(?[Rr]ank %d+%)?%s*$', '')))
	local size = tonumber(frame.args.size) or 22   -- 22px fits in a line of text
	return '<span class="aa-skilltip-ico" style="width:' .. size .. 'px;height:' .. size .. 'px;">' .. pic(d.icon, size) .. '</span><span class="aa-skilltip-name">' .. esc(name) .. '</span>'
end

-- a tile of Module:Skilltree: the icon (it follows the version / chain card that is shown) and the full card
-- (versions and chain included) that opens on hover; ranks and ovs (by skill id) are optional
function p.tip(id, ranks, ovs)
	return render({ id = tostring(id), ranks = ranks, ovs = ovs, tileicon = true })
end

return p
